digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate criterion and acceptance-criteria evidence classification
propositions: Plan review must validate that externally verifiable acceptance criteria are tagged with exactly `[operator-attested]` and reject untagged or malformed near-miss tags with remediation guidance showing the correct syntax.
Plan review must detect codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged `[operator-attested]` and explain that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Acceptance criteria mixing repository and external-world proof must be rejected with guidance to split into independently certifiable criteria rather than silently assigned one evidence kind.

The new evidence-kind criterion must achieve 100% precision on genuine external criteria without the tag, 100% recall on named incident cases (A1, 115b, 8c4f), and macro precision/recall ≥ 0.90 across a frozen evaluation corpus.
High-confidence evidence misclassification findings must participate in normal validity-impact blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory.
